title: Spot the Scam
goal: Recognize the common red flags in financial scams.

cards.text: Scams often rush you, promise easy money, or ask for your PIN or a one-time code.

voice.speak_text: Scams often rush you, promise easy money, or ask for your PIN or a one-time code. Say next to continue.

cards.text: In your country, {group_percent}% of {who} {indicator}. The more we pay by phone and online, the more chances scammers get.

voice.speak_text: In your country, {group_percent} percent of {who} {indicator}. The more we pay by phone and online, the more chances scammers get. Say next to continue.

cards.text: A message says: You won a prize! Send {cur}50 today to claim it. Is this a scam or safe?

voice.speak_text: A message says: You won a prize! Send {cur}50 today to claim it. Is this a scam or safe? A: scam. B: safe. Say A or B.
voice.correct_feedback: Correct. Paying to receive a prize is a red flag.
voice.incorrect_feedback: Not quite. The answer is A. Paying to receive a prize is a red flag.

cards.text: Fake job offers that ask for a fee first are a common scam.

voice.speak_text: Fake job offers that ask for a fee first are a common scam. Say next to continue.

cards.text: A job offer asks you to pay a fee before you start. What should you do?

options.a: Pay the fee to get the job
options.b: Refuse, because real employers do not charge you to start
options.c: Pay half now and half later

voice.speak_text: A job offer asks you to pay a fee before you start. What should you do? A: pay the fee to get the job. B: refuse, because real employers do not charge you to start. C: pay half now and half later. Say A, B or C.

spoken_options.a: pay the fee to get the job
spoken_options.b: refuse, because real employers do not charge you to start
spoken_options.c: pay half now and half later

voice.correct_feedback: Correct. Real employers do not charge you to start.
voice.incorrect_feedback: Not quite. The answer is B. Real employers do not charge you to start.

cards.text: Scammers may pretend to be a family member in trouble.

voice.speak_text: Scammers may pretend to be a family member in trouble. Say next to continue.

cards.text: A message says it is your child and they need money now. What do you do first?

options.b: Call them back on a number you already know

voice.speak_text: A message says it is your child and they need money now. What do you do first? A: send the money right away. B: call them back on a number you already know. C: reply with your PIN. Say A, B or C.

spoken_options.b: call them back on a number you already know

voice.correct_feedback: Correct. Call them back on a number you already know.
voice.incorrect_feedback: Not quite. The answer is B. Call them back on a number you already know.

cards.text: Be careful with links in messages. Banks never ask for your PIN or password by message.

voice.speak_text: Be careful with links in messages. Banks never ask for your PIN or password by message. Say next to continue.

cards.text: Someone calls saying they are from your bank and asks for your one-time code. What do you do?

options.b: Hang up and call your bank on its official number

voice.speak_text: Someone calls saying they are from your bank and asks for your one-time code. What do you do? A: give them the code. B: hang up and call your bank on its official number. C: give them your PIN instead. Say A, B or C.

spoken_options.b: hang up and call your bank on its official number

voice.correct_feedback: Correct. Your bank will never ask for your code. Call the official number yourself.
voice.incorrect_feedback: Not quite. The answer is B. Your bank will never ask for your code. Call the official number yourself.

cards.text: An investment promises to double your money in one week with no risk. Is this a scam or safe?

voice.speak_text: An investment promises to double your money in one week with no risk. Is this a scam or safe? A: scam. B: safe. Say A or B.
voice.correct_feedback: Correct. Big, fast, risk-free returns are a red flag.
voice.incorrect_feedback: Not quite. The answer is A. Big, fast, risk-free returns are a red flag.

cards.text: If you think you were scammed, tell your bank right away and report it to {scam_report_agency}.

voice.speak_text: If you think you were scammed, tell your bank right away and report it to {scam_report_agency}. Say next to continue.

cards.text: Slow down, never share your PIN or codes, and check before you send money.

voice.speak_text: Remember: slow down, never share your PIN or codes, and check before you send money. Say next to finish the lesson.
